plain_english_policy: Allocate state funds to remediate contaminated, abandoned industrial/commercial sites.
evidence_quote: Use state funds to clean up former industrial and commercial sites that are contaminated, unused or abandoned.
review_reason: This option is procedurally neutral—it does not inherently lean conservative (+1) or progressive (-1). It is a funding mechanism for environmental cleanup, which can be supported across the political spectrum depending on implementation details (e.g., scope, prioritization, or source of funds).
